title: Chapter 1437 - 12: Endless Stairway (Part 2)

Chapter 1437 - 12: Endless Stairway (Part 2)

Chapter 1437 - 12: Endless Stairway (Part 2)

Lin Yuan sighed inwardly under the corrosion of the blood-red sky power.

However, he wasn't worried. His Taiji Primordial Spirit was distinctly different from the main battle forms of other lords.

The Taiji Primordial Spirit is not essentially a physical body but a Primordial Spirit form. Although it transforms into flesh and blood, it remains fundamentally an illusory Primordial Spirit Power.

And Primordial Spirit Power... as long as Lin Yuan's will and mind are extinguished, Primordial Spirit Power will naturally dissipate, eliminating the possibility of being captured alive.

Lin Yuan didn't even need to deliberately extinguish the Taiji Primordial Spirit, just disperse his will, and the Taiji Primordial Spirit would fall into irreversible annihilation.

"Still, I've gained enough this time."

Lin Yuan looked at the towering crimson figure overlooking him, "Before dispersing my will, perhaps I can try summoning my future self."

By understanding the scene of the Blood Sea Lord summoning the future self, Lin Yuan, though not truly a Time Lord, could attempt to summon his real future self.

Yet, limited by strength and realm, Lin Yuan could by no means reach the level of the Blood Sea Lord, who summoned future selves from hundreds of great destruction cycles later.

At most, it's just a future self from several million years later.

Several million years later... The timeline Lin Yuan observed of several million years later is extremely blurry; what his future self is doing then is uncertain in his mind.

Lin Yuan had also observed the future timelines of other time beings, which were extremely blurry for a while, but not perpetually blurry for millions of years.

However, in several million years, the infinite dimensional dimensions basically no longer contained any information related to him, even the Chaos Void disappeared, as if it had never appeared.

That is precisely why.

Lin Yuan then asked the towering crimson figure if any lords had transcended in that space-time, or if any events related to transcendence had occurred.

After all, the counterpart comes from the true future.

"Begin."

Lin Yuan's mind began spreading along the timeline towards the future. In a vague sense, with Lin Yuan at the center, the timelines in all directions started to become chaotic.

"Hmm?"

"Is he also summoning his future self?"

Numerous Time Lords realized Lin Yuan's intention at once.

Like the Blood Sea Lord, he was also summoning the future self.

"According to the attitude of the Blood Sea Lord's future self just now, this one's future is likely also a Legendary Lord, two futures are both Legendary Lords, battling in the current space-time?"

The numerous Time Lords were shocked, their faces expectant.

One Legendary Lord making a move is exceptionally rare; two Legendary Lords battling, especially future Legendary Lords battling in the present space-time?

This might not happen once in several or dozens of great destruction cycles.

"Also summoning the future?"

The Blood Sea Lord's expression changed as well, looking at the towering crimson figure behind him and seeing no reaction, he relaxed.

With a future self already having stepped into the legendary level, even if Lin Yuan becomes a Legendary Lord in the future, he can't do anything to him.

Whoosh!

The timeline twisted and blurred.

Behind Lin Yuan, scenes of blurred illusions emerged.

"Which old fellow is it?"

The towering crimson figure observed closely. He had just acted to force out the presence behind Lin Yuan.

Wanting to see clearly which Legendary Lord's arrangement it was.

Yet, in the next moment.

The towering crimson figure saw an image imprinted deep in its soul.

Accompanied by scenes of blurred illusions flashing by, tier upon tier of white jade steps emerged behind Lin Yuan.

The white jade steps seemed both real and illusory, coming from some scene in the future, yet upon their appearance, they began impacting the current space-time, everything in contact, including the power of the blood-red sky, started irreversibly turning to nothingness.

The white jade steps stretched endlessly upward, boundless and without beginning or end, as if leading to the highest point of the infinite dimensional dimensions.

"Hmm?"

Including the Blood Sea Lord, all Time Lords were puzzled, as lords who roam the infinite dimensional dimensions, was there anywhere they hadn't seen? But this white jade staircase leading to who knows where... not only had they not seen it, they hadn't even heard of it.

"This is the fourth..."

Compared to the puzzlement of the other Time Lords, the towering crimson figure widened eyes full of incredulity and disbelief.

"No need to continue the summoning, Your Excellency..."

The towering crimson figure immediately spoke, a look of fear flashed across his face: "Revealing key scenes from the future in the current space-time, this, this will incur an irresistible backlash, it's entirely unnecessary, entirely unnecessary."

"What do you mean?"

Lin Yuan was also observing the endless stairs behind him, these endless stairs gave him a sense of déjà vu.

At the same time.

The timeline continued to be disrupted, and the steps of white jade continued to extend upward, finally revealing an extraordinary scene at some height.

In this scene, not only were there white jade stairs, but also a figure appeared.

This figure had its back turned to all the Time Lords, slowly ascending the stairs.

The white jade stairs were endless, without beginning or end, and a sense of solitude permeated the surroundings of this figure, as if he was the only one in the immense world.

"Is it you?"

The majestic crimson figure's mind went blank, far more incredible than seeing the steps of white jade earlier.

The disruption of the timeline spread, and the figure slowly ascending seemed to sense something.

The right foot, which was about to step onto the next stair, paused slightly.

Then with a wave of a sleeve.

The originally disrupted timeline instantly collapsed completely, swiftly spreading towards the current space-time.

The blood-red canopy power exerted by the majestic crimson figure started to disintegrate without suspense, and an invisible essence instantly arrived, directly erasing the majestic crimson figure out of thin air.

Who exactly was that figure slowly ascending the stairs? What level of strength did they possess? What was their relationship with Lin Yuan? Or could it be Lin Yuan's future self?

This scene left the surrounding Time Lords unresponsive for a long time.

A dignified Legendary Lord, even a Legendary Lord from future space-time, was erased so effortlessly?

Who exactly was that figure slowly ascending the stairs? What level of strength did they possess? What was their relationship with Lin Yuan? Or could it be Lin Yuan's future self?

To so easily erase a Legendary Lord, even one in the third stage of 'Endless Tribulations,' was incredibly powerful, right? Perhaps even surpassing the Lord Wanwei?

The invisible essence continued to spread.

"No, no." The Blood Sea Lord looked at this scene with horror and despair.

Because, having lost the protection of the majestic crimson figure, the direction of the spreading invisible essence was coming towards him.

Whoosh.

The consciousness of the Blood Sea Lord vanished in an instant.

The same happened to the Void Spirit Lord and the Lord of Armor behind him, their consciousness was directly obliterated.

The invisible essence did not cause any physical harm to the three Lords' bodies, but their consciousness was forcibly erased.

"What is this?"

The Time Lords watching the battle felt a chill as they looked at this scene.

It was too shocking.

Even a Legendary Lord couldn't erase the consciousness of a second-tier ultimate Lord so easily, right?

Not to mention that the Blood Sea Lord had also stepped into the Legendary tier in the future?

...

In the space-time three hundred major destruction cycles later.

The Blood Sea Lord suddenly opened his eyes, his incarnation descending into the past was forcibly obliterated, and his true self naturally knew this immediately.

"I didn't expect it was that existence, it was that existence..."

The Blood Sea Lord's mind trembled, "I never heard that this existence had been to Wanwei space-time, never heard at all..."

The Blood Sea Lord actually had an answer in his heart.

That existence did indeed visit Wanwei space-time, but this matter had never been disclosed.

In the timeline he originally experienced, under normal circumstances, the past of that existence would not summon the future self.

Because of his interference, it led to the past of that existence summoning the future self, causing even greater variables to occur.

"My luck..."

The Blood Sea Lord looked desperate, because an invisible essence from past space-time had already crossed over hundreds of major destruction cycle years, arriving at this moment, coming to envelop him.

The next moment.

The true self of the Blood Sea Lord was obliterated.

At the same time.

The invisible essence continued to spread across multiple timelines.

The past Blood Sea Lord, the present Blood Sea Lord, the future Blood Sea Lord, the weak Blood Sea Lord, the strong Blood Sea Lord, countless Blood Sea Lords, all at different time periods, were all obliterated at the same time.

...

On an endless stairway of white jade, a figure shook its sleeve, glanced down, and continued to slowly ascend the stairs.
